subject: [PATCH v2 6/6] efi: respect the poisoned pages coming from previous kernel

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Suggested an alternative fix by making the page allocator consume the table and not do memblock_reserve() here, which would involve poisoning struct pages for the memory on init.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, Aug 24, 2026 at 06:03:05AM -0700, Breno Leitao wrote:
> Yea, this seems better in fact. Let me know if that matches what you
> had in mind.

Yes!

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

reviews.author: Breno Leitao
reviews.summary: Agreed with the alternative approach and provided a rough outline of the changes, including dropping memblock_reserve() altogether and poisoning recorded frames at mm_core_init().

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Confirmed that the alternative approach was what he had in mind and thanked Breno for his input.
reviews.raw_body:

2026-08-24.patch_summary: The patch author and Breno Leitao discuss an alternative approach to handling poisoned pages from the previous kernel, involving poisoning recorded frames at mm_core_init() after memblock_free_all().
